from.blocks: W2's first three blocks (REST, SUS, HOLD of 39), unchanged: E98's probe; no H-F32

blocks.name: REST
blocks.title: the rest reading: no launch, the 10 Hz sampler on the idle card; the last 60 s are the reading

blocks.name: SUS
blocks.title: sustained: nine back-to-back 8 s processes (~76 s) from a die reading <= 57 C (E80's, E83's and E87's SUS), in a fixed order

blocks.name: HOLD
blocks.title: the hold: 39 back-to-back 8 s processes (~5.5 min) of one unclamped kind; the last 120 s are the reading
